examples.name: Simple Platformer
examples.description: A basic platformer game with jumping, moving platforms, and collectibles. Player can move left/right and jump to reach the goal.

examples.name: Snake Game
examples.description: Classic snake game where you collect food to grow longer. Avoid hitting walls or your own tail.

examples.name: Space Shooter
examples.description: Top-down space shooter where you pilot a ship, shoot enemies, and dodge incoming fire. Survive as long as possible.

examples.name: Endless Runner
examples.description: Infinite runner game where you jump over obstacles and collect coins. The game speeds up as you progress.

examples.name: Top-Down Adventure
examples.description: Explore a top-down world, collect items, and avoid enemies. Use arrow keys to move in all directions.

examples.name: Match-3 Puzzle
examples.description: Classic match-3 puzzle game. Click adjacent gems to swap them and create matches of 3 or more.
